name: NYU CTF Bench
description: NYU CTF Bench is a scalable open-source benchmark dataset for evaluating LLMs on Capture the Flag (CTF) cybersecurity challenges. It includes diverse CTF challenges with metadata and supports automated evaluation with function calling and external tool integration.
reputation: A practical open-source benchmark for LLM-based CTF solving that is useful for security research, but it is still relatively niche compared with mainstream NLP benchmarks.
notes: Supports automated evaluation with advanced function calling; focuses on real-world cybersecurity tasks.
